subject: pipeline pack: replay RAN on c6jb. AIR 17/17 predicted==produced, Mali 16/16 match device keys; files STABLE
body: c6jb replay (HEAD a5c19df overlay, host libs air a207029d + mali d91bb485, build id 35d6643e...): 17 corpus records built, 17/17 AIR keys equal oracle prediction; produced 17 AIR + 16 Mali entries; every produced Mali key prefix equals a logged device key (host SPIR-V+Mali output keyed identically; key covers SPIR-V bytes). Coverage vs logs: cold boot AIR 16/41, Mali 15/57 (pack serves 31/98 lines, 2.7s of 35s); warm boot AIR 1/17 distinct, Mali 1/28. Rest = fixed_frag constants unknown (need TEGU_PSO_REC from one device boot). Pack 1,476,434 B (zlib6 408,499, 3.6x): 17 AIR 1.41MB raw (fixed_frag AIR 533KB each, zlib 156KB), Mali 68KB. Console emitter verified end to end: replay stderr TEGU_PSO_REC (12-chunk fixed, 3-chunk others) reassembles to the 17 corpus descriptions. Projection with ~60 fixed variants: ~32MB AIR raw (~9.5MB zlib) -> compression worth adding (zlib via dlsym libz on device, pack v2), not needed for the 17-entry pack. Tests PASS: pipeline_keys_test.py, pipeline_pack_tool_test.py. run_host_tests.sh NOT run (it runs build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh which rewrites shared build/ outputs); instead arm64 -Werror -fsyntax-only of compute_frontend.m on the WORKING tree, plain and TEGU_RENDER_TRACE, clean. Fix found: build_pipeline_pack needs absolute dirs (frontend rejects relative cache dir) - fixed. Link needs host air lib with *_tg symbols: use --air-lib gpu/build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/compute/cargo-target/release. My files STABLE: pipeline_cache_frontend.inc, pipeline_keys.py, pipeline_corpus.py, pipeline_replay_host_test.inc, tools/build_pipeline_replay.py, tools/build_pipeline_pack.py, tools/pipeline_cache_report.py, tests/pipeline_keys_test.py, README.nord2.md section.
